latest_release.name: FractalAndroid v1.0.0
latest_release.body: Initial institutional v1.0.0 release by Fractal Compute Orchestrations. Includes Kotlin Int4BlockCodec (FRQ4 and FRQD binary wire compatibility with FractalCore), OperationControl thermal gating (battery <= 40.0 C and PowerManager THERMAL_STATUS_SEVERE checks), FractalPaths canonical path-safe storage, JVM unit test suite, passing Android CI + Gradle dependency submission, and pre-built debug APK under FRACTAL Proprietary Source-Available & Non-Commercial Restrictive License v3.1.
